description: Full reference for a single OneSource REST API endpoint: parameters, request body, example response, price, use cases, and a ready-to-run curl command. Accepts an operation ID or a path. Use 1s_list_endpoints or 1s_search_use_cases first if you do not know which endpoint you need. Free, no authentication required.

endpoint.description: Either an operationId (e.g. `chainAllowance`) or a path (e.g. `/api/chain/allowance` or `chain-allowance`).
